newsitem.title: USA: Sonat says oil well flows 3,840 b/d.
newsitem.headline: Sonat says oil well flows 3,840 b/d.

text.p: Sonat Exploration Co said Tuesday its Scobee No. 1 well in Vernon Parish, La., flowed 3,840 barrels of oil and 9.5 million cubic feet of natural gas per day with.
It said the flowing wellhead pressure was at 3,225 pounds per square inch gauge.
The well, Sonat Exploration's first company-operated well, is located in the Hurricane Branch area of the Eastern Austin Chalk trend in Vernon Parish, it said.
Sonat Exploration, a unit of Sonat Inc, has a 60 percent working interest in the well," it said.
Sonat Exploration said the well was drilled to a vertical depth of 14,100 feet and then horizontally to a total of 7,250 feet to develop the fractured Austin Chalk formation.
Sonat Exploration said it is operating four drilling rigs in the Eastern Austin Chalk trend and is working interest owner in two partner-operated wells being currently drilled.
The company said it plans to maintain this activity level in 1997.
